fields.name: accessRole
fields.short: The user's access role for this calendar.

fields.name: anyoneCanAddSelf
fields.short: Whether anyone can invite themselves to the event (deprecated).

fields.name: attachments
fields.short: File attachments for the event.

fields.name: attendees
fields.short: The attendees of the event.

fields.name: attendeesOmitted
fields.short: Whether attendees may have been omitted from the event's representation.

fields.name: colorId
fields.short: The color of the event.

fields.name: conferenceData
fields.short: The conference-related information, such as details of a Google Meet conference.

fields.name: created
fields.short: Creation time of the event (as a RFC3339 timestamp).

fields.name: creator
fields.short: The creator of the event.

fields.name: defaultReminders
fields.short: The default reminders on the calendar for the authenticated user.

fields.name: description
fields.short: Description of the event.

fields.name: end
fields.short: The (exclusive) end time of the event.

fields.name: endTimeUnspecified
fields.short: Whether the end time is actually unspecified.

fields.name: etag
fields.short: ETag of the resource.

fields.name: eventType
fields.short: Specific type of the event.

fields.name: extendedProperties
fields.short: Extended properties of the event.

fields.name: gadget
fields.short: A gadget that extends this event.

fields.name: guestsCanInviteOthers
fields.short: Whether attendees other than the organizer can invite others to the event.

fields.name: guestsCanModify
fields.short: Whether attendees other than the organizer can modify the event.

fields.name: guestsCanSeeOtherGuests
fields.short: Whether attendees other than the organizer can see who the event's attendees are.

fields.name: hangoutLink
fields.short: An absolute link to the Google Hangout associated with this event.

fields.name: htmlLink
fields.short: An absolute link to this event in the Google Calendar Web UI.

fields.name: iCalUID
fields.short: Event unique identifier as defined in RFC5545.

fields.name: id
fields.short: Opaque identifier of the event.

fields.name: items
fields.short: List of events on the calendar.

fields.name: kind
fields.short: Type of the resource ("calendar#event").

fields.name: location
fields.short: Geographic location of the event as free-form text.

fields.name: locked
fields.short: Whether this is a locked event copy where no changes can be made to the main event fields "summary", "description", "location", "start", "end" or "recurrence".

fields.name: nextPageToken
fields.short: Token used to access the next page of this result.

fields.name: nextSyncToken
fields.short: Token used at a later point in time to retrieve only the entries that have changed since this result was returned.

fields.name: organizer
fields.short: The organizer of the event.

fields.name: originalStartTime
fields.short: For an instance of a recurring event, this is the time at which this event would start according to the recurrence data in the recurring event identified by recurringEventId.

fields.name: privateCopy
fields.short: If set to True, Event propagation is disabled.

fields.name: recurrence
fields.short: List of RRULE, EXRULE, RDATE and EXDATE lines for a recurring event, as specified in RFC5545.

fields.name: recurringEventId
fields.short: For an instance of a recurring event, this is the id of the recurring event to which this instance belongs.

fields.name: reminders
fields.short: Information about the event's reminders for the authenticated user.

fields.name: sequence
fields.short: Sequence number as per iCalendar.

fields.name: source
fields.short: Source from which the event was created.

fields.name: start
fields.short: The (inclusive) start time of the event.

fields.name: status
fields.short: Status of the event.

fields.name: summary
fields.short: Title of the event.

fields.name: timeZone
fields.short: The time zone of the calendar.

fields.name: transparency
fields.short: Whether the event blocks time on the calendar.

fields.name: updated
fields.short: Last modification time of the event (as a RFC3339 timestamp).

fields.name: visibility
fields.short: Visibility of the event.

fields.name: workingLocationProperties
fields.short: Developer Preview: Working Location event data.
